value.rationale: The known repeated-permutation family is a canonical benchmark with polynomial SAS but exponentially many MAS. The theorem solves its complete, naturally motivated smallest-nonbinary (q=3) length-resolved MAS enumeration for every k, a stronger object than growth bounds, first coefficients, or a routine arbitrary slice; exact integer certificate and rational GF make the invariant reusable.
